full_judgment: 2. The petitioner's case is that the petitioner was an examinee of Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) Examination, 2000 from Humanities Group of Shallkupa Government Degree College under the Intermediate and Secondary Education Board, Jessore (hereinafter referred to as -'Board'). In all 304 students from Shailkupa Government Degree College appeared in the HSC Examination, 2000 in the Humanities Group including the petitioner. Results of 49 students including the petitioner were withheld by the respondent No. 2 and 3 when the result of HSC Examination, 2000 was published on 26.8.2000. At the time of admission into the College of respondent No. 5 the College authority made it mandatory to take 3 optional subjects and one fourth subject out of 5 subjects taught in the College. The petitioner took Civics, Islamic Studies and- Logic as optional subjects and Islamic History as fourth subjects, So also 48 other students made their choice as per the instruction on the Admission Form of the College. A blank photocopy of the Admission Form which is claimed to have been given to the petitioner for filling up is annexed as Annexure-A to the petition. The petitioner and 48 students paid their examination fees including tuition and other charges to the college during two years of their study in the college. On completion of two academic years of study the petitioner and 48 other students including other examinees (255 in. number) of the college filled up the Forms for appearing in HSC final Examination, 2000 and sat for the final examination which was held on 27.4.2000 and 'appeared in all the subjects without any problem from any authorities whatsoever.
